build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a ladder and falling ball puzzle scene
add_dynamic_bodies: create dynamic bars and balls in the PHYRE scene using C.add with scale and position
update_task_relationships: define the task goal by setting body relationships like ABOVE using C.update_task
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to PRE_BALL using C.set_meta on the task creator
skip_invalid_params: raise SkipTemplateParams when the ball position is too low relative to the ladder top
